name: RevitMCPCommandSet
description: Basic command collection for Revit AI assistance

commands.description: Displays a greeting dialog
get available family types
get current view elements
get current view info
get selected elements
Create point-based elements like furniture
Create line based element such as wall
Create surface-based elements like floors
Color elements by parameter value
Annotate Filled Region (Цветовая область) on room boundaries of the active floor plan
Annotate Text notes with optional leaders (выноска) on the active floor plan
Tag all the walls in the model
Deletes elements using ElementId
AI element filter for querying elements by criteria
Operate on elements (select, color, hide, isolate, etc)
Extract all rooms with detailed properties including area, volume, perimeter, and parameters
Aggregate structured TEP data: building footprint, total area, storey count, per-level areas, volume, rooms by purpose
Export room finish data: wall/floor/ceiling finish parameters (read-only); face materials opt-in, level filter and offset/limit pagination for large models

Квартирография/ТЭП: group rooms into apartments by apartment-number parameter, compute living/useful/total areas with СП РК 3.02-101-2012* А.8 coefficients (loggia 0.5, balcony/terrace 0.3, veranda 0.8), per-apartment list and summary by type
Calculate material quantities and takeoffs with area and volume calculations per material
Analyze model complexity with element counts by category, type, family, and level
Compare schedule element counts against model elements for Doors, Windows, Floors, or CurtainWalls (doors/windows exclude slopes; curtain walls count systems, not panels)
Export structured curtain wall (витражи) schedule data: wall systems by Curtain type with mark, length x height, level, and count — panels and mullions excluded
Read full ViewSchedule definition: fields, filters, sorts, groups, and display flags
Create grid system with smart spacing generation for project layout (alphabetic/numeric naming)
Configure 2D grid extents and bubble display on floor plans for existing grids
Create structural beam framing system with configurable spacing and direction
Create and place rooms at specified locations with custom names, numbers, and properties
Create a straight single-run stair between two levels using a StairsType from the project (normative width from server)
Create a railing by path or hosted on a stair using a RailingType from the project
Cut a floor slab opening or create a vertical shaft between levels (stair/lift/MEP) — profile as rect or boundaryPoints in mm
Create tags for all rooms in the current view displaying room name and number
Create levels at specified elevations with automatic floor plan view generation
Execute dynamic C# code in Revit with access to the Document and Revit API
Create dimension annotations between elements or points in the current view
Create chained wall dimensions for a room: interior width+depth chains by default, exterior only on explicit request
Create exterior axial dimension chains offset from the full building envelope (inter-axis + overall; numbers bottom, letters left)
Export structured door schedule data for door blocks only (excludes slopes/reveals), and optionally create a real Revit ViewSchedule when createViewSchedule=true
Export structured window schedule data for window blocks only (excludes slopes/sills), and optionally create a real Revit ViewSchedule when createViewSchedule=true
Export floor finish экспликация data: (полы)* only with areaM2, excluding slabs/insulation/facade
Create floor экспликация from seeded recipe columns; discover (полы)* levels and typified ranges (same type+footprint) with dynamic titles
Create a ViewSchedule from project template with fields, filters, sorting, and grouping
Edit an existing ViewSchedule in-place: column widths, hide/show columns, filters, sorts, groups, and display flags (REV-68)
Make an existing ViewSchedule fit a target sheet width by hiding optional columns, narrowing columns proportionally, and/or adding a level filter (REV-68)
Create a sheet with a project title block
Place a view or schedule on a sheet at coordinates in millimeters
Create a room finish schedule set: reproduces the ADSK_RU chain (key styles → data filling → output list) or a single schedule from a template
Execute multiple Revit commands in one request with partial success (plugin built-in, max 20 commands)
Return project annotation styles: dimensions, grids, text note types, line patterns, graphics styles, and title blocks
Read all parameters of an element by id (name, value, units, read-only flag)
Read parameters for multiple elements in one ExternalEvent (batch, max 100 ids)
Write a parameter value on an element by id inside a transaction
Extract room geometry metrics: width/depth/area and corridor width hints
Extract nominal/clear door width, maneuvering space, egress-path hints, and ramp slopes
Export the egress walkability graph of a floor: room boundary polygons (mm) and doors with from/to room links for evacuation distance tracing
Draw polylines as detail curves on the active plan, detail callout, or drafting view (mm coordinates) — evacuation routes or node sketch lines
Create a detail view for nodes: callout of a parent view around an element/area, or an independent drafting view, with name, scale, and detail level
Place point-based or line-based 2D detail components on a detail/drafting view by family and type name, with partial success per item
Create a text note on a view with optional wrapping width and a straight leader (node annotations)
Extract window sill height and door/window opening height for norm checks (REV-58)
Extract stair width/riser/tread, ramp width/slope, railing height for norm checks (REV-59)
Check room depths against a normative min/max limit, report and optionally highlight violators
Pilot normative check: doors required to be fire-rated on egress routes or between compartments
Check evacuation corridor widths against a normative minimum, report and optionally highlight violators
Check minimum dimensions of balconies, loggias, and fire piers against normative limits, report and optionally highlight violators
Write norm-check results into the model: status parameter, marks, highlight, violation schedule (with preview and overwrite protection)
Automatically lay out views and schedules on a sheet: row packing by actual extents, title-block-aware usable area (incl. Form 3), auto-scale oversized viewports, no overlaps
Render a TEP table on the 'Общие данные' sheet: layout from a reference schedule, values from export_tep_data, text notes and grid lines
